sa_market_summary: The Toyota Corolla Cross is South Africa's best-selling compact crossover and the eighth-best-selling model overall, with 6,001 units sold in 2025. Built locally at Toyota's Prospecton plant in KwaZulu-Natal, it bridged the gap between the Corolla hatch and the RAV4. Its hybrid variant dominates the new-energy vehicle segment ,  nearly 40% of all used hybrids sold in SA in 2025 were Corolla Cross units. The 1.8-litre petrol (103kW/172Nm) and 1.8-litre hybrid (90kW combined) both use a CVT driving the front wheels. Resale value is exceptional, and the hybrid battery carries an 8-year/195,000km warranty.

known_faults.description: Contaminated or low CVT fluid can cause the transaxle bearing to whine. Particularly reported on vehicles where CVT fluid was not changed at the recommended intervals.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Listen for a whining noise from the transmission at low speeds. Request CVT fluid change history. The CVT should feel smooth with no hesitation.
known_faults.estimated_repair_zar: R4,000 - R14,000 (fluid flush to bearing replacement)
known_faults.source: Toyota SA dealer reports, Corolla Cross owners forums, AutoTrader SA buyer guides

known_faults.description: Pre-2025 models used a foot-operated parking brake instead of an electronic handbrake. Owners found it awkward and unintuitive, though not a mechanical failure.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Check that the footbrake engages and releases smoothly. Verify the electronic handbrake on 2025+ facelift models works correctly.
known_faults.source: Cars.co.za owner reviews, CARmag SA reviews

known_faults.description: The hybrid battery cooling fan can produce noticeable noise, particularly in hot weather or after sustained driving. Normal operation but can be disconcerting to new hybrid owners.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Listen for fan noise from the rear seat area after a test drive. Ensure hybrid system warning lights are off.
known_faults.estimated_repair_zar: R1,500 - R5,000 if fan replacement needed
known_faults.source: Toyota SA hybrid owner communities, MyBroadband forums

what_to_inspect_before_buying: Request CVT fluid service history ,  neglected CVT fluid is the most common preventable issue
Check for full Toyota SA service history with dealer stamps
Verify remaining warranty coverage (3-year/100,000km on vehicle, 8-year/195,000km on hybrid battery)
Test hybrid battery health ,  the system should show good EV range even after a short charge
Inspect for accident repair, especially on the front bumper and grille (expensive trim pieces)
Check infotainment and wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto connectivity
Listen for any transmission whine during low-speed manoeuvring
Review the service plan usage ,  6 services/90,000km included
owner_sentiment: Very positive. Corolla Cross owners appreciate the hybrid's fuel economy (claimed 4.3L/100km in hybrid form) and the comfortable ride quality. The 1.8 petrol is adequate rather than exciting. Main complaints include the foot-operated parking brake on pre-facelift models and CVT droning under hard acceleration. Toyota's dealer network is uniformly praised. Hybrid resale values are notably strong.
